segments.mil7.7.3:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘cittakadharakummassa [cittakathalakummassa (sī. pī.)] ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.7.3:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, cittakadharakummo udakabhayā udakaṃ parivajjetvā vicarati, tāya ca pana udakaṃ parivajjanāya āyunā na parihāyati,
segments.mil7.7.3:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena pamāde bhayadassāvinā bhavitabbaṃ, appamāde guṇavisesadassāvinā.
segments.mil7.7.3:1.4: Tāya ca pana bhayadassāvitāya na parihāyati sāmaññā, nibbānassa santike upeti [ṭhapeti (ka.)].
segments.mil7.7.3:1.5: Idaṃ, mahārāja, cittakadharakummassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
